What does this record establish about declared aluminum alloy for cylinder head?

RESEARCH RECORD [MEZGER-M026]:
Application: Xtreme aftermarket Porsche head programs, including 3.6 to 4.0 L Turbo. Component: cylinder head. The reviewed factual register records declared aluminum alloy as RR350. Evidence status: supplier_declared. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Supplier declaration. Not an OEM Porsche casting identification; exact chemistry and heat treatment not specified. Source locator: Our Programs, general manufacturing paragraph
